title: Oven Simmered Filipino Rice Noodles Pancit Bihon
description: A diabetic-friendly Filipino dish featuring rice noodles simmered in a mixture of chicken broth and apple cider vinegar, served as a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken broth, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then add the rice noodles to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Simmer the noodles in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the pancit bihon hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
